exposure: CA severity (severe, moderate and severe combined)
CA body system affected (cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, genitourinary)
cohort: Individuals born in 1964-1976 from the population-based Jerusalem Perinatal Study cohort who survived to at least 18 years of age.
finding: Individuals born with congenital anomalies who survive to adulthood have an increased risk of premature mortality, which is modified by the anomaly's severity and the affected body system.
